verdict.rationale: AI Gateway is itself an API product. It documents OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoints that work with a base URL swap, a public JSON models endpoint with pricing and capabilities, and per-request routing, caching and BYOK controls via providerOptions.gateway. Authentication uses API keys or OIDC that work from any infrastructure, and a public openapi.json and llms.txt/markdown docs are machine-readable. Missing for 10: evidence that management functions (budgets, logs, spend) can be driven by API rather than only the dashboard, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.
